'''Ryota Iwasaki''' (Japanese: '''岩崎諒太''' ''Iwasaki Ryōta'') is a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Iwasaki was born sometime on July 1 in {{wp|Osaka Prefecture}}, {{wp|Japan}}. He started working on {{aniseries|PTS}} during {{aniseries|SM}}, mainly voicing minor characters. Iwasaki's most notable roles so far are [[Mr. Electric]] and [[Gladion's Zoroark]]. He is currently affiliated with the talent agency Atomic Monkey.
